component.name: Live for Speed Linux
component.summary: Unofficial community Linux launcher for Live for Speed

description.p: Live for Speed Linux is an unofficial community launcher for the untouched official Live for Speed Windows build.
Version 0.3.0 bootstraps exact LFS 0.8C20 new graphics, which upstream labels PUBLIC TEST rather than stable.

On first launch, one informed setup prompt downloads official files, verifies every protected game and Wine runtime file, configures exact Wine 11.15-1 and DXVK D3D11/DXGI, and starts the game. Versioned updates completed by LFS are recorded after exit and accepted on later launches.
Live for Speed is proprietary software from Scawen Roberts, Eric Bailey, and Victor van Vlaardingen. This community wrapper is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Live for Speed developers.
Bootstrap exact public-test LFS 0.8C20 and preserve versioned in-game updates as verified local baselines for later launches.
Upgrade official GitHub Actions to their Node 24 major releases and keep CI and Pages maintenance current.
Prevent main content from overflowing its grid track and obscuring the desktop status sidebar.
Migrate to exact public-test LFS 0.8C19 new graphics with private DXVK D3D11/DXGI, actionable channel checks, and player-safe atomic upgrades.
Add browser-side report sanitization, schema-complete GitHub handoff, sensitive-ticket quarantine, and linked-pull-request E2E coverage.
Add plain-language support forms, deterministic ticket triage, contributor queues, and a compact maintainer dashboard.
Introduce the original text-free Velocity L icon for clear rendering at desktop and menu sizes.
Adopt the Live for Speed Linux name and a new community-owned website design.
Adopt a descriptive public name while preserving the command and player state paths.
Initial community wrapper with verified downloads, private DXVK, diagnostics, and AUR packaging.
